notes: Memory-only run: no wall/CPU speed comparisons are drawn from sampled coordinators.
Fresh coordinator per method/workers/round; one warmup plus three paired measured rounds for workers1/4.

Both methods freshly prepare identical source content/executable modes before sampling; the digest must match timing. Seed IDs and commit timestamps are distinct. Post-setup coordinator resident memory is included.
The coordinator, native worker threads and inherited Git/npm/Node descendants are included; sampler is outside the group.
Maxima are sampled sums of current counters, never sums of individual lifetime maxima.
Queries are sequential, not an atomic group snapshot; brief children/spikes can be missed. No exact peak or strict lower-bound claim.
RSS can double-count shared pages; charged footprint includes compressed memory and is not unique system RAM.
Group membership covers inherited descendants. Known escaping children invalidate the pass; unobserved detached descendants remain a sampling limitation.
Any incomplete sweep makes that phase's peak unavailable; raw samples and exit races are retained in samples.jsonl.
Only ready/remove/reclaim are sampled; fixture preparation and digest/smoke validation are excluded.
Sampler CPU, sample spans/gaps, correctness and cleanup are recorded separately. No public result claimed before review.

comparison_method.scope: Default create jobs=4 only, one or four simultaneous requests; no jobs2 memory measurements.
comparison_method.statistics: Medians of three measured batches after one retained warmup per configuration; all 16 batches / 48 phases preserved. Ranges are observations, not confidence intervals.
comparison_method.lifecycle: Maximum sampled group sum across ready/remove/reclaim within each batch, then median across batches. Independent process lifetime peaks are never summed.
comparison_method.processes: Includes post-setup coordinator, native worker threads and inherited descendants; excludes sampler and setup/validation phases.
comparison_method.limitations: Sequential process queries are not atomic; transient processes/spikes and unobserved detached descendants can be missed. Known escapes/incomplete access invalidate a phase. No exact peak or strict lower-bound claim. RSS may double-count shared pages; footprint is charged memory, not unique RAM.
comparison_method.sampling: 5 ms target only. Per-phase sweep times, maximum gaps and sampler CPU remain in every original row; timing from this sampled pass is not a performance comparison.
comparison_method.fixture: Content/symlink-target and executable-mode digest, lockfile and dependencies match timing. Fresh seed commits and Git metadata byte counts remain distinct and are preserved per batch.
comparison_method.units: Bytes; MiB=1048576 bytes. Difference is folder minus Git/npm; ratio is Git/npm divided by folder.

export_provenance.preservation: Every measurement, phase counter, status, hash and row order is unchanged; only absolute fingerprint labels and fixture paths become role labels.
export_provenance.unpublished_artifacts: Per-PID sample log, command logs and full coordinator reports are not exported. Recorded filenames are identifiers only; the original sample-log hash is retained.
